title: Who cares if Shams Charania reported on the NBA MVP award?

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Who cares if Shams Charania reported on the NBA MVP award?
sources.description: A strange media dustup has emerged in recent days, after ESPN's Shams Charania reported that Oklahoma City's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has won the 2025-26 NBA MVP award.
